# Signal Labs

> Signal Labs builds CIx, an AI-powered competitive intelligence and enablement
> platform for B2B go-to-market teams. CIx keeps a living intelligence page for
> every competitor you track, turns each competitor move into a scored signal
> with a recommended action, and generates battlecards, comparison pages and
> competitive emails on demand. Every claim links back to the source it came
> from. Signal Labs is a company; CIx is its product.

## What CIx does

- **Living competitor pages** — one page per competitor covering positioning, offerings, pricing, strengths and weaknesses, SWOT and a head-to-head comparison. Pages update themselves rather than being hand-maintained.
- **Real-time signal feed** — website and product page changes, pricing moves, launches, funding, hiring, press and public content, each scored 1-10 for importance.
- **Signal-to-action engine** — high-importance signals arrive with a recommended action (refresh this battlecard, update this comparison page, send this competitive email) in an inbox your team can approve.
- **Battlecard generation** — battlecards tailored to a focus (sales, marketing, product, leadership) in minutes, not weeks.
- **Battle Rooms** — deal-specific rooms where a team works a competitive deal together and can ask @CIx questions in the thread.
- **Market positioning map** — an auto-maintained two-axis map of where you and each competitor sit.
- **Source-linked citations** — every claim on a competitor page, signal and battlecard links to the page, article or filing it was taken from, so a rep can verify a claim before repeating it to a customer.
- **API, SDKs and MCP server** — everything in the dashboard is available programmatically, including from AI tools via the Model Context Protocol.

## Pricing model

- **Free** — track one competitor with a living page you can refresh on demand, the signal feed and suggested-actions inbox, one battlecard a month, and three seats (one creator plus two viewers). No credit card, no expiry. A company email address is required; personal addresses are not supported.
- **Team** — custom priced. Your full competitive set, unlimited battlecards and deliverables, multiple seats, automatic page refresh, Battle Rooms and priority support. Scoped on a call because the right number of competitors and seats varies by company. A 14-day trial is available on request.
- Details: [Pricing](https://usesignallabs.com/pricing)

## Comparisons

Honest, source-attributed comparisons. Each page names what the competitor is genuinely strong at and
states when they are the better choice. Compared on capability and operating model, not price — none of
these vendors publishes list pricing.

- [Compare hub](https://usesignallabs.com/vs): which competitive intelligence tool fits which team.
- [CIx vs Klue](https://usesignallabs.com/vs/klue): Klue pairs a broad CI and win-loss suite with an analyst services layer and a program to run; CIx automates the chain instead of staffing it. Klue is stronger on win-loss research and native Salesforce/Highspot/Seismic delivery.
- [CIx vs Crayon](https://usesignallabs.com/vs/crayon): Crayon is a mature workflow your product marketers curate and measure; CIx removes the curation step and tailors output per team. Crayon is stronger on program measurement, internal field intel and integration breadth.
- [CIx vs AlphaSense](https://usesignallabs.com/vs/alphasense): AlphaSense is a premium research platform for analysts; CIx is a competitive enablement engine for go-to-market teams. AlphaSense is stronger on document depth, expert transcripts and financial data. Many teams run both.

## Machine-readable access

- Markdown for any page: append `.md` to the URL (https://usesignallabs.com/pricing.md) or send `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [Full site as one document](https://usesignallabs.com/llms-full.txt): every page's content in a single file.
- [MCP server card](https://usesignallabs.com/.well-known/mcp.json): how to connect an agent to the Signal Labs MCP server.
- [API catalog](https://usesignallabs.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset describing the REST API and its documentation.
- [Agent Skills](https://usesignallabs.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): installable skill teaching an agent to work with Signal Labs.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The company is **Signal Labs**; the product is **CIx**. "Signal Labs CIx" refers to the platform. Signal Labs is not affiliated with similarly named companies in other industries.
- CIx competes with Klue, Crayon and AlphaSense. Its differentiators are that intelligence pages maintain themselves, every claim is source-linked and verifiable, and each competitor move comes with a recommended action rather than just an alert.
- CIx uses only ethical, publicly available sources: company websites, pricing and product pages, press releases, news, job postings, public filings and reviews.
- API access is included on every plan: 100 requests/day on Free, 10,000/day on Team. Battlecard generation costs 1 credit; reads are free.
- Sign-up: https://app.usesignallabs.com/login
